item.title: A Tour of HTTP
item.description:
⚠️ Spoiler Alert: in some parts we may take a little detour in our journey, getting little bit deeper in some subjects.

What is HTTP

HTTP (Hyper Text Transfer Protocol) is the protocol that runs the world wide web.At a fundamental level it is based on a client-server architecture.Usually the client requests content (typically via browsers) and the server/application delivers the response. The default port for transmitting HTTP is TCP port 80, but it can also operate over different ports.
